node.title: Re^3: If statement issue from a Noob
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Note that the extra set of braces around print FH_OUTFILE "\n"; makes it look at first glance like you're missing an else when you're actually not (since it seems this is based on [1nickt]'s initial [id://1200664|code]), I recommend removing them. Also, you should take [holli]'s [id://1200672|advice] (and as several others have shown) to use more descriptive variable names.

I apologize in advance for the bad formatting

Why apologize when you can fix it? ;-) Or at least have [mod://perltidy] do it for you.
